The name Sadeeqa is often given to girls to encourage them to uphold these qualities throughout their lives and to be a example of truth and sincerity for those around them. In Arabic speaking cultures, it is not uncommon for individuals to be known by multiple names, and the name Sadeeqa may be used as a term of endearment or respect.

In the Quran, the term saadiq (truthful) is used to describe Prophet Muhammad, who is considered the embodiment of truth and sincerity. The name Sadeeqa serves as a reminder of the importance of truthfulness and sincerity in one's relationship with God. The name also serves as a reminder of the importance of being truthful and sincere in one's dealings with others, as this reflects the character of God. The name Sadeeqa encourages individuals to strive for excellence in their character and to be a reflection of God's truth and sincerity in their interactions with the world.
